subject: Skyward Systems vendor onboarding — DPA, SOC 2 link, and subprocessor list
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@skywardsys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@skywardsys.com
Date: 2029-12-01T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor setup request — Skyward Systems

Hi Jordan,

We're ready to be added as a vendor in Redwood so we can start the pilot next month. Attached are the initial items your procurement team requested: a completed vendor form, our corporate W-9, and a short subprocessor export.

Quick context: we'll be sending monthly invoices for usage-based billing and need a PO on file before we invoice. Can you confirm the PO routing contact and whether Redwood requires a specific PO template? Also, we can provide a redlined DPA if needed — we've got a signed copy we typically share after review.

Attachments: vendor_intake_form.pdf (pdf), Skyward_W9.pdf (pdf), subprocessors_snapshot.csv (csv)

Thanks,
Samir Patel
Head of Procurement, Skyward Systems
procurement@skywardsys.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@skywardsys.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2029-12-01T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup request — Skyward Systems

Samir — thanks for the quick turnaround. Welcome, excited to get Skyward set up. A couple items from procurement/finance we need to close before we can create the PO and accept invoices:

- Signed DPA (or counter-signed copy) and a SOC 2 report or link to the auditor-hosted report.
- Full subprocessor list with host locations (we need EU/US flags).
- Billing remit address and tax ID exactly as it should appear on the PO.
- Bank wire or invoice email contact for finance@redwood.inference.com.

We use a standard PO template; Irene can initiate PO creation once we have the DPA and finalized billing details. If you can send the DPA as a PDF and a SOC 2 link, I will route to finance and legal for a quick sanity check.

Also looping in Laura from Finance for PO and payment terms (Laura — FYI, this is Skyward; they requested monthly usage invoices).

Best,
Jordan
Account Lead — Vendor Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@skywardsys.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: procurement@skywardsys.com
Date: 2029-12-01T14:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup request — Skyward Systems

Jordan — attached the signed DPA and a CSV of subprocessors (exported from our privacy portal). Also included is a short text file with the SOC 2 auditor link and access instructions.

Attachments: Skyward_DPA_signed.pdf (pdf), Skyward_subprocessors_2029.csv (csv), Skyward_SOC2-2028-link.txt (txt)

SOC 2 access: https://secure-audit.example.com/clients/skyward/soc2-2028 (username: redwood_onboard, note: one-time access code will be sent separately).

We are US-headquartered; tax ID and remit address are on the attached W9. Please confirm PO number format (we can accept PO: RDW-<7digits>), and we'll match it to invoices.

Thanks — Samir

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@skywardsys.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2029-12-02T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup request — Skyward Systems

Hi Samir — thanks for the docs, they look complete on first pass. A few follow-ups from Procurement/Legal/Finance before we finalize PO creation: 

1) DPA: Legal has a couple of small verification asks (data retention clause dates and our request for a subprocessors notification timeline). We don't need a full redline at this stage; would you accept our standard vendor DPA addendum via DocuSign? If yes, I'll start the envelope.

2) SOC 2 access: the link and credentials are sufficient for initial review. Our security team will pull the auditor's statement. Expect a short confirmation request from secops.

3) Subprocessors CSV: could you add a column for host country and whether data is encrypted at rest (yes/no)? That helps our privacy gate. If you can't update the export, we can accept a short follow-up email with that mapping.

4) PO routing: Laura will issue the PO. Our PO format is RDW-#{7 digits}. Please confirm the invoice remit email (for PO matching) and whether Skyward needs a specific PO contact at Redwood on the invoice.

I'll prepare the DocuSign addendum and loop legal if we need further negotiation. Attached is a procurement checklist to speed the intake (procurement_checklist.pdf) — this is just a checklist, not a contract.

Attachments: procurement_checklist.pdf (pdf)

Regards,
Irene Choi
Vendor Operations — Redwood Inference

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@skywardsys.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2029-12-03T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup request — Skyward Systems

Irene — thanks. Confirming the following so we're aligned: 

- We'll accept the standard DPA addendum via DocuSign and will sign within 48 hours of receipt.
- Invoices will be sent to invoices@skywardsys.com with the PO number RDW-1234567 placed in the subject line. (Our accounting team has been informed.)
- Subprocessors CSV: we'll follow up with a small CSV update including host country and encryption column by EOD tomorrow.
- Remit address and tax ID are in the attached W9 (attached again here).

Attachments: Skyward_W9.pdf (pdf)

I'll watch for the DocuSign link and the PO number. Looking forward to the pilot.

Best,
Samir
Head of Procurement, Skyward Systems
procurement@skywardsys.com
